ImageDescription.value:
Name: Lod Mosaic Museum
Description: In 1996, during salvage excavations, an amazing and impressive mosaic was discovered, one of the most complete and impressive to be discovered in Israel and the world. The mosaic dates back to the Roman period, 3rd-4th centuries AD, is 17 meters long and 9 meters wide. It consists of approximately 2.4 million mosaics, stone and glass and includes 30 colors and shades.
